name: SIT Birrul Waalidain Bogor
address: Jl. Raya Salabenda–Semplak No.12, Parakan Jaya, Kemang, Kabupaten Bogor 16310

notes.id: Uang pangkal = Dana Sumbangan Pendidikan (DSP). Uang masuk minimal 50% dibayar paling lambat 10 hari setelah diterima; sisanya bisa dicicil. Biaya bersubsidi silang. SPP tidak dicantumkan.
notes.en: Entry fee = education contribution (DSP). At least 50% of the entry payment is due within 10 days of acceptance; the rest can be paid in instalments. Fees are cross-subsidised. Tuition not listed.

notes.id: Uang pangkal = Dana Sumbangan Pendidikan (DSP). Uang masuk minimal 50% dibayar paling lambat 10 hari setelah diterima; sisanya bisa dicicil. Biaya bersubsidi silang. SPP tidak dicantumkan. Santri mondok: sewa tempat tidur, lemari, kasur (3 tahun) Rp3.000.000.
notes.en: Entry fee = education contribution (DSP). At least 50% of the entry payment is due within 10 days of acceptance; the rest can be paid in instalments. Fees are cross-subsidised. Tuition not listed. Boarders: bed, wardrobe and mattress rental (3 years) Rp3,000,000.

period.id: Dibuka mulai Desember 2023, offline (sekretariat Jl. Salabenda–Semplak No.12) dan online.
period.en: Opened from December 2023, in person (secretariat at Jl. Salabenda–Semplak No.12) and online.

steps.en: Fill in the online guest book.

steps.id: Transfer biaya pendaftaran (Rp500.000 TK; Rp600.000 SD & SMP) dan konfirmasi via WhatsApp atau email.
steps.en: Transfer the registration fee (Rp500,000 TK; Rp600,000 SD & SMP) and confirm by WhatsApp or email.

steps.id: Panitia mengirim undangan tes penjajakan dan wawancara orang tua.
steps.en: The committee sends an invitation to the placement test and parent interview.
Attend the placement test at the school.

steps.id: Hasil seleksi dikirim; jika diterima, bayar minimal 50% uang masuk dalam 10 hari.
steps.en: Results are sent; if accepted, pay at least 50% of the entry fees within 10 days.

test.id: Tes penjajakan dan wawancara orang tua.

notes.id: Usia per Juni 2024: Play Group 3–4 tahun, TK A 4–5 tahun, TK B 5–6 tahun.
notes.en: Age as of June 2024: Playgroup 3–4, TK A 4–5, TK B 5–6.
